WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
), erf AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS artifact_id,
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS e(k, v)) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
)
SELECT MAX(cpi.cpi * erf.erf) AS max_avs
FROM cpi JOIN erf ON erf.artifact_id = cpi.artifact_id

WITH r AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::int AS year, "TEMPc" AS temp
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
  WHERE "readTS" >= '2023-01-01' AND "readTS" < '2026-01-01'
), y AS (
  SELECT year, AVG(temp) AS avg_temp FROM r GROUP BY year
)
SELECT y.year, ROUND(y.avg_temp, 2) AS avg_temperature,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(r.temp - y.avg_temp) > 0 AND ABS(r.temp - y.avg_temp) <= 4) AS anomaly_count
FROM y JOIN r ON r.year = y.year
GROUP BY y.year, y.avg_temp
ORDER BY y.year
note: Counts individual readings (not distinct days) whose |temp - yearly avg| is in (0,4]; no 2023 data exists.

answer:
WITH latest_env AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (case_link) case_link, "RH", "TEMPc"
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
  ORDER BY case_link, "readTS" DESC
), art_rh AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.art_exam) c.art_exam, le."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" c JOIN latest_env le ON le.case_link = c.case_exam
  ORDER BY c.art_exam, c.assess_date DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS registry_number, a.art_title AS title, a."MatKind" AS material_type,
       s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS humidity_sensitivity,
       CASE WHEN (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'High' AND ar."RH" > 55)
              OR (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'Medium' AND ar."RH" > 60)
            THEN 'Over Exposure' ELSE 'Within Limits' END AS exposure_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN art_rh ar ON ar.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
WHERE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' IN ('Medium', 'High')
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"
note: 'Secondary, more cautious threshold' read as the Humidity Exposure Thresholds (High >55% RH, Medium >60% RH); current RH = latest reading of the artifact's showcase (via ConditionAssessments).

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, ra.risk_level,
       r."HIST_sign" AS historical_significance,
       (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ra.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
WHERE ra.risk_level IN ('High', 'Medium')
  AND r."HIST_sign" > 8
  AND (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int > 20

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL
), art_maint AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.art_exam) c.art_exam, cm.budget_alloc, cm.budget_stat
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" c
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam
  JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = e.monitor_code
  ORDER BY c.art_exam, e."readTS" DESC
)
SELECT cpi.dynasty, cpi.cpi_score, am.budget_alloc AS budget_allocation, am.budget_stat AS budget_status
FROM cpi LEFT JOIN art_maint am ON am.art_exam = cpi.artifact_id
note: 'Generalized budget status' read as ConservationAndMaintenance.budget_stat; budget linked artifact->ConditionAssessments->showcase->latest reading->maintenance.

WITH erf AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS artifact_id,
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS e(k, v)) AS erf_score,
         (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.k, f.v)
            FROM jsonb_each(s.env_handling_sensitivity) AS g(gk, gv),
                 LATERAL jsonb_each_text(g.gv) AS f(k, v)
           WHERE f.v = 'High') AS high_sensitivities
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name, erf.erf_score, erf.high_sensitivities
FROM erf JOIN "ArtifactsCore" a ON a."ARTregID" = erf.artifact_id
WHERE erf.erf_score > 4
ORDER BY erf.erf_score DESC

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming', 'Qing')
)
SELECT artifact_id, title, dynasty, cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi_score > 7 THEN 'High Priority'
            WHEN cpi_score > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority'
            ELSE 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM cpi
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC

WITH latest_env AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (case_link) case_link, "TEMPc", "RH"
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
  ORDER BY case_link, "readTS" DESC
), art_env AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.art_exam) c.art_exam, le."TEMPc", le."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" c JOIN latest_env le ON le.case_link = c.case_exam
  ORDER BY c.art_exam, c.assess_date DESC NULLS LAST
), sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS artifact_id,
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS e(k, v)) AS erf,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS e(k, v)
           WHERE v = 'High') AS high_count
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name,
       ae."TEMPc" AS current_temperature, ae."RH" AS current_humidity,
       COALESCE(s.high_count, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN (a."ageYears" * s.erf * POWER(ae."RH" - 50, 2) * ae."TEMPc") / 100000.0 > 5
             AND COALESCE(s.high_count, 0) >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN art_env ae ON ae.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN sens s ON s.artifact_id = a."ARTregID"
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"

SELECT DISTINCT case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
WHERE case_link IS NOT NULL AND ("tempVar24" > 1 OR "RHvar" > 3)
ORDER BY case_link

SELECT DISTINCT s."caseID" AS showcase_id
FROM "Showcases" s
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = s."caseID"
WHERE (10 - ((e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0 + (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3)) < 5
   OR ((CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) >= 3
ORDER BY s."caseID"
